subject.title: ci: migrate to shared release pipeline

question: Should notcrawl intentionally retire the Cloudsmith APT/RPM repository distribution path in favor of GitHub release assets and Homebrew, and if so what migration or deprecation commitment applies to existing package-repository users?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes a currently configured distribution channel; code review cannot determine whether breaking those package-manager update paths is an accepted release-policy decision.

options.title: Retain Cloudsmith during migration
options.body: Keep the existing APT/RPM publishers until a supported replacement and communicated sunset path are available.

options.title: Approve immediate retirement
options.body: Accept the distribution break and add explicit migration guidance for users currently configured against Cloudsmith.

recommendation.title: Retain Cloudsmith during migration
recommendation.body: Keep the existing APT/RPM publishers until a supported replacement and communicated sunset path are available.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied release context links this contributor to both the proposed shared-pipeline migration and the current release-signature process.
